title: GMO | 1g Live Rosin | AIO
description:
GMO | 1g Live Rosin | AIO

Crafted from premium Umamii flower grown at our farm in Wyoming, New York, our GMO 1G Full Spectrum Single Source Live Rosin O2 Vape delivers the complete expression of the plant—capturing the cannabinoids, terpenes, and flavor that make this legendary cultivar a favorite among solventless enthusiasts. Every step of the process, from cultivation and harvest to ice water extraction, rosin pressing, and hand-filling, is completed by the Umamii team, ensuring true single source quality from seed to shelf.

An indica-dominant hybrid bred from GSC × Chemdawg, GMO (Garlic Cookies) is renowned for its unmistakably bold terpene profile. Expect layers of savory garlic, pungent diesel, earthy spice, and rich herbal funk, balanced by subtle notes of pepper and creamy sweetness for a deeply satisfying full-spectrum experience.

Filled into a premium O2 all-glass, cottonless vape, this 1-gram device contains 100% solventless live rosin with no additives, no fillers, and no artificial ingredients—just pure, full-spectrum cannabis. The result is a smooth, flavorful draw that stays true to the original flower.

GMO is prized for its deeply relaxing, body-forward effects, making it an excellent choice for unwinding at the end of the day. Expect a calming cerebral lift that gradually melts into full-body comfort, making this cultivar ideal for quiet evenings, relaxing after a long day, or simply slowing down and savoring the moment.

title: Tropical Z | B-Side | 14g
description:
Tropical Z | B-Side | 14g

Tropical Z has a punchy and sweet aroma with a distinctly orange citrus zest that lingers in your nose bringing to mind island fruit and shaved ice. Glittering trichomes seamlessly blend the fuzzy clumps of pistils with the mottled sage and deep greens of the margins creating the illusion of a fuzzy orange nug when held at arms length. These large, medium density nugs have a distinctly sharp conical shape. The flavor is citrusy and creamy on the pull, just like a frosty creamsicle. In contrast, the exhale is dry and woody but not unpleasant. A prime example of an excellently engineered sativa dominant strain. Perfect for staying focused and getting things done without leaving you feeling paranoid or overly caffeinated. Perfect for daytime and late night use.

For a lot of people, their first taste of AlienLabs was through Mars OG or Lemon Fuel OG and with this strain, we wanted to bring that feeling back. While they’ve long been labeled as indicas, we see them as the perfect expression of a balanced hybrid delivering both the cerebral and physical power that even high tolerance users crave.

Potentially low dose blended with smokable botanicals that offer a calming effect and promote a relaxed mental state, while improving cognition and managing stress.

Cannabis Strain : should be chosen for its reputation as balanced hybrid or indica dominant that increases creativity. Look for descriptions of creative, focus, detail oriented, mental clarity.

Terpenes to look for :
• Ocimene (Sweet/Herbal): - Known for its uplifting effects, which can help with
productivity and focus.
• Terpinolene (Woody/Floral):- helps promote alertness and a "get in the zone"
feeling.
• Bisabolol (floral): Helps to quiet a busy mind just enough to enter a creative flow
state
• Beta-Caryophyllene (Peppery): Acts as a grounding agent, providing anxiety
relief that channels energy into creative productivity rather than jitters.
• a-Humulene: provides a "clear-headed" and "steady" influence, making it ideal for
mindfulness practices, deep meditation, or centering rituals where alertness is
needed.

Botanicals added :
• Tulsi>Holy Basil : As a sacred "sattvic" plant, it is considered a bridge to the
divine that helps move stagnant energy and provides a gentle, calming, and
protective experience. A known adaptogen, meaning it helps the body manage
physical and emotional stress. When smoked, it provides a gentle, relaxing
experience. Tulsi is used as an herb to aid in transition and forward movement.
The smoke has a unique, mild earthy taste with hints of mint and clove.
• Sage (Salvia officinalis) : aroma of burning sage is often used in aromatherapy to
reduce anxiety, stress, and promote a sense of calm. When smoking its reported to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and enhance cognitive function, potentially reducing agitation. Known for boosting cognition and helping to clear respiratory
congestion

title: RSO | Dablicator | 1g
description:
RSO | Dablicator | 1g

What is RSO?
RSO is one of the most potent and natural cannabis extracts available. Unlike refined oils, RSO keeps the full spectrum of compounds from the plant– THC, CBD, cannabinoids, terpenes, and flavinoids all working together for stronger, longer-lasting effects. Many people choose RSO for help with sleep, pain relief, and overall wellness.

How to Use RSO
With the Dablicator pen, using RSO has never been easier. Just twist and click to dispense a rice-grain-sized drop - no mess, no syringes, no guesswork. You can dispense directly onto a spoon to injest, add it to a smoothie or warm beverage, or add it to foods (like a cookie or cracker). It can also be disolved into butter or oil for cooking.

How do I use Dablicator?
Dablicator is easy to use! First, take the green cap off the tip. Then, holding the oil tank with one hand, twist the body of the dablicator– as the device twists, a dispensor button will extend from the bottom. There will be black lines at .025ml intervals and one red line at a .15ml interval. Each batch of RSO will have a different potency, so it is important to review the information on your product's label for exact dosing information.

Once you’ve twisted to your desired dose, press the button to dispense the oil. When you’re done dispensing oil, just twist back on the body to stop the flow of oil. When you first use a new Dablicator, you will need to prime it by going through the above steps to use the device and push any residual air pockets out. Once you’ve cleared this air pocket, you’ll be able to use the Dablicator as described above. Visit headandhealthc.com for further instruction on how to use your Dablicator.

This is your end-of-day reward, your Friday night unwinding companion, your reason to just slow down.

title: Cake Bomb | Indoor Flower | 3.5g
description:
Cake Bomb | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Cake Bomb is a rare and potent indica-dominant hybrid from Prolific Coast Seeds, built on the formidable genetics of Do-Si-Dos crossed with PCS1, a complex blend that includes WiFi3 and a powerful pairing of Scott's OG and Casper OG. The buds glisten with frosty trichomes and give off a captivating aroma of sweet bakery, earthy depth, and a fuel-forward OG funk that announces its lineage before you even light up. On the smoke it delivers bold notes of lemon zest, woody sweetness, and a slightly minty spice before settling into one of the more satisfying body highs this side of the menu. The high arrives fast, opens with a wave of euphoric uplift, and then transitions into a full, relaxing body buzz that is hard to argue with.

title: Amherst Sour Diesel | Indoor Flower | 3.5g
description:
Amherst Sour Diesel | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Amherst Sour Diesel is a sativa-dominant powerhouse that was made popular in WNY, bringing together Chemdawg genetics with Amherst Super Skunk to create a strain that honors the classic diesel tradition while adding its own distinct West Coast character. The buds are dense and resin-coated, releasing an intoxicating blend of pungent diesel, tropical fruit, and exotic wood the moment the jar opens. On the inhale the flavor comes through rich and gassy with bright fruity undertones, and the high follows quickly with an uplifting, long-lasting cerebral buzz that keeps energy and mood elevated for hours. Everybody has tried a cut of the original Sour Diesel but have you tried the Western NY version?

title: Honey Banana | Indoor Flower | 3.5g
description:
Honey Banana | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Honey Banana is exactly what it sounds like: sweet, sticky, and satisfying. Bred from Strawberry Banana and Honey Boo Boo by Elemental Seeds, this heavy-handed hybrid delivers buds so coated in resin they glisten like fresh honeycomb. The aroma rolls out in warm waves of ripe banana, tropical fruit, and natural honey with a subtle earthy base that keeps it grounded. The flavor stays true to the nose through and through, and the effects hit with a weighty full-body calm balanced by a bright cerebral buzz that leaves you giggly, content, and floating somewhere pleasant. It is the kind of strain that turns a quiet evening into a good one.

title: Cap Junky | Indoor Flower | 3.5g
description:
Cap Junky | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Cap Junky is the result of a landmark collaboration between two of the most respected names in modern cannabis breeding, Capulator and Seed Junky Genetics, and the result is exactly as good as that pedigree suggests. A cross of Alien Cookies and Kush Mints #11, Cap Junky produces dense, trichome-drenched buds with a complex aroma of gas, fermented fruit, pine, and a cool minty sharpness that cuts right through the funk. The flavor on the inhale leans sour and fruity before shifting to a peppery, smooth exhale with a lingering sweetness that keeps you coming back. The high is powerful and well-rounded, opening with euphoric mental clarity and a wave of creative energy before settling into a deep full-body relaxation that never quite tips into sedation.

title: Tourbillon | Indoor Flower | 3.5g
description:
Tourbillion | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Tourbillon is a sativa-dominant hybrid from Aficionado Seeds that was personally selected by breeder Leo out of a 360-plant sift, which tells you everything you need to know about how seriously this strain was crafted. A cross of Biscotti with a complex blend of Triangle Kush, Cherry Pie Kush, and Grateful Breath, Tourbillon expresses deep OG and Cherry Pie Kush character without any of the typical Gelato softness you might expect from a Biscotti cross. The aroma is bold and unmistakable, layers of lemon rind, jet fuel, ethanol, and starter fluid that hit like a cold engine roaring to life. The high follows suit with an intense, old-school cerebral rush akin to classic Headband, keeping the mind sharp, focused, and fully lit while the body stays functional and grounded.

LIVE RESIN | Shishkaberry Badder 1g

Shiskaberry, part of the MFNY Classics lineup, was a big part of the conversation when British Columbia was setting the global standard for premium cannabis. Bred in 1996, “Kish” is known for its mixed berry upfront, warm earth underneath, and meditative finish that doesn't rush anywhere. MFNY Classics aren’t throwbacks, they’re living proof of what we can do by infusing old-school cultivars with modern processes. All to bring these legendary, full-of-life flavors and effects to New Yorkers.
MFNY’s Shiskaberry badder is a premium concentrate made in house, using hydrocarbon extraction method. It starts with our best, in-house grown, bred, and fresh-frozen Shiskaberry buds. We flash freeze our plants right after harvest to lock in all the trichome-and-terpene-rich goodness of the plant (this is the “Live” part of Resin). Upon the first inhale of MFNY’s Shiskaberry, you are inundated by strong notes of berries with undertones of earthiness; known to promote a relieving body high with long-lasting, invigorating cerebral effects. Live Resin badder concentrate has a soft, butter-like texture for an easy-to-use, super enjoyable experience. Our Live Resin concentrates are exclusively single-source and produced at the highest of standards in our state-of-art laboratory space, using scientific precision and years of experience, which we’ve proudly gathered together in New York's Hudson Valley.

title: Rum Cake | 3.5g Flower
description:
Rhum Cake, is a hybrid of Wedding Cake and SunFuel, offering a sweet aroma and smooth icing fuel flavor, blending gas and rum vanilla cream. This gem has a darker green hue and bright orange hairs and coated in thick white crystals. This Indica-leaning hybrid guarantees a unique relaxing experience, reminiscent of savoring the finest confections from Kingston's esteemed Baker.
Rhum Cake is more than just a premium strain, it's a sensory journey deeply rooted in the soul of Jamaica. Infused with the island’s rich vibes and the enduring spirit of Rastafari culture, every bud tells a story. The Baker who holds it down at the Cake

Shop dispensary on legendary Orange Street, this strain is born from tradition and the essence of the Rastafari culture. Working hand-in-hand with the ever-watchful Screw Face, the duo forms the right and left hands of King Clementine, the mastermind of the herb scene in Jamaica. Their operation stretches far beyond city corners all across the map. Deep in the bush, Dreaddie cultivates fire herbs, while Queen Kushite, regal and grounded, tends to the Gully. From hills to kitchens, every leaf and bud of Rhum Cake is touched by purpose, community, and High Vibration intention. This is Rhum Cake, a strain steeped in Legacy, Loyalty, and the Highest Grade.

Genetics & Breeder Overview for Rhum Cake
• Genus: Indica dominant Hybrid

o A finely balanced hybrid leaning toward indica traits. Rhum Cake delivers a soothing body high with a clear-headed, uplifting cerebral experience—ideal for users who want both mental clarity and physical calm.

• Genetics: Wedding Cake x SunFuel
o Wedding Cake Famous for its rich dessert-like flavor, creamy vanilla, and tangy undertones. Known to deliver powerful euphoria and deep physical relaxation. A favorite among those seeking stress and pain relief with a sweet, dense smoke.

o SunFuel is a sativa-leaning hybrid celebrated for its uplifting and focused high, with gassy, citrus, and pine-forward notes. It brings vibrant energy and clarity, balancing Wedding Cake’s heavier indica effects with a refreshing cerebral spark.

• Breeder: Heavyweight Heads
o Renowned for producing premium top-shelf cannabis strains that deliver both extremely flavorful and powerful effects. Heavyweight Heads is committed to high-quality genetics and robust terpene profiles. True champions in their craft.
Top Terpenes & Effects
Terpenes:
1. ß-Myrcene
o Effect: Provides a relaxing effect while enhancing the flavor with earthy, herbal undertones.
o Aroma: Musky, earthy, and sometimes a bit spicy, adding depth to Island Sunshines’s flavor profile.
2. Caryophyllene
o Effect: Known for its anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving properties. Offers a soothing body effect without heavy sedation.
o Aroma: Spicy and peppery, with a warm woody kick, brings a bold and grounding edge to the flavor.
3. D-Limonene
o Effect: Uplifting and anti-anxiety refreshing profile.
o Aroma: Bright, citrusy, and zesty, it’s the perfect complement to the clementine flavor
Effects:
• Mental: Euphoric, focused, and mood-lifting. Rhum Cake delivers creative stimulation and mental clarity without overactivation, making it perfect for daytime focus or inspired sessions.
• Body: Smooth and calming. Provides light body relaxation and stress relief without inducing couch-lock or
drowsiness. Great for staying active while feeling at ease.
• Best For: Creative projects, Daytime stress management, Outdoor adventures, Social settings, Mood enhancement without brain fog.

title: LIVE ROSIN | Chemdog | 510 Cart | .5g
description:
Chemdog l Live Rosin 510 Cart .5g

Chemdog is one of the godfathers of modern cannabis history — the genetic backbone of Sour Diesel, OG Kush, and GMO/Garlic Cookies among others. It’s the second of the MFNY Classics that pay homage to the strains that shaped modern cannabis — and the highs they first brought us. MFNY Classics aren’t throwbacks, they’re living proof of what we can do by infusing old-school cultivars with modern processes. All to bring legendary, full-of-life flavors and effects to New Yorkers.
At MFNY, we make RiverwayTM Live Rosin in a specific way that preserves powerful plant characteristics. We do this to highlight the difference between “real” live rosin and misleading alternatives on store shelves. Riverway isn’t just a name, it’s a promise to make products all New Yorkers can be proud of.
The Riverway Live Rosin Vape has a high terpene profile of our single-source, in-house produced Chemdog Riverway Live Rosin. We use a proprietary cultivation, freezing, and extraction process designed to preserve flavor, maximize potency, and ensure a truly solventless experience. This solventless extract showcases the cultivar’s naturally produced full-spectrum cannabinoids and remarkable terpenes. Upon the first inhale of MFNY’s Chemdog, your pallet will be met with a striking chemical and funk taste with undertones of earthiness; known to promote an euphoric body high with long-lasting, invigorating cerebral effects that spread to your whole body. No distillates, added flavors, or alterations.
Comes in a 510 Cart with recommended battery settings 2.8 - 3.3V. Do not vaporize live rosin at higher temperatures, as it can “burn off” the precious terpenes and aromas we are working hard to preserve; higher temps can also cause an undesirable “burnt” aftertaste. Vape cartridge contains concentrated live rosin oil that is heated by a battery and vaporized for inhalation. These products are very potent and are designed to be consumed in 2-3 second puffs.

Every terpene note from each parent shows up - a tribute to the pheno hunting behind this cut. Effects are energetic and happy at the onset before the indica body weight takes over. Strong, lasting, and firmly in the 'hide the snacks' category.

Effects are focused and euphoric without a paranoid edge, making it genuinely useful across the full day and into the night. An excellently engineered sativa dominant strain that proved immediately it belonged on every shortlist.

The smell places you in a spice market at noontime, seeking shade under the eaves of a hookah joint - herbal, sweet, citrusy, and minty in the slow swirl of heat. title: Permanent Shade | Indoor | 3.5g
description:
Permanent Shade | Indoor | 3.5g

Permanent Shade is Alien Labs crossing two of the most recognizable genetics in the Connected/AL catalog - Permanent Marker and Nightshade - and the result is every bit as heavy as that combination suggests. Dark green and purple, tree-shaped buds are absolutely drenched in trichomes. This is a strain built for potency in the fullest sense: high cannabinoids, loud terps, and an effect that will settle you into the couch and keep you there. The profile is connoisseur-grade and layered - a mix of sweet top notes, nostril-stinging ethanol on the nose, and a creamy, candy-like finish on the inhale with a slight astringency that keeps it interesting. Alien Labs' own warning: hide the snacks. The munchies arrive in full force and don't leave. This is a nighttime-only strain for most users, built for real decompression and not much else. Chase total cannabinoids, not just THC - this one rewards the full spectrum approach.

description:
Grape Ape (Live Resin) | 1g Live Resin 510 Cart

People go bananas for the Grape Ape strain for several reasons. Grape Ape has high concentrations of the terpenes myrcene, pinene, and caryophyllene in it due to the crossing of Mendocino Purps, Skunk, and Afghani strains. The parent strains of this Grape Ape are some of the first recorded strains ever used to create a lot of the OGs we see today.
When smoking Grape Ape, users have reported feeling a boost in appetite, deeply relaxed, and even sleepy, also noting some pain, stress, and anxiety relief. Side-effects may include dry mouth, dry eyes, and feeling a little dizzy. Not to worry though; the effects are only temporary and can potentially subside to a calm sedation.

It comes on in five to ten minutes, with a gentle head high that encourages free association, creative thoughts, and calming of tension. In fact, many users of Orange Creamsicle weed use it as an easy way to keep their mood and their muscle even all day long.

This is also the case for medical marijuana users. The mild but noticeable effects of the strain don’t interrupt your normal functions, so people with anxiety and depression can use it as a pick-me-up while still achieving their goals for the day. Dark thoughts are muted and worries aren’t as worrying while Orange Creamsicle is in effect.

title: Stündenglass Kompact Gravity Infuser - Black
description:
Introducing the newest sensation from Stündenglass, the Kompact Gravity Infuser. The Kompact features the same patented 360° gravity system, dynamic design, and immersive experience as the original, now available in a more refined, portable size that includes a custom-fit travel case.

Coming in at just under a foot tall, the Kompact is exactly what you need to enjoy the benefits of Stündenglass in an easy to handle package. The smaller globes hold about two thirds of the volume, or 2 cups, compared to the full size, which creates cooler and faster pulls.

The travel case is carefully crafted with high grade fabric and form-fitted to cradle the Kompact Stündenglass, which arrives full assembled. A beautiful metal inlayed logo plate adorns the front with an easy to use zipper, carrying handle and strap for over the shoulder use. Inside, there is space for accessories including a handy pocket to store anything extra you want to bring along with you.

Designed for functional versatility, the Kompact Gravity Infuser is a complete set that includes an aluminum bowl kit and a glass liner but can also connect to any smoking or vaporization device with a 14mm male joint. Also included is a 3-foot silicone hose that can be connected to the 45° adjustable mouthpiece for direct draws or a steady stream of smoke for contactless consumption.

The Kompact is a sophisticated and elegantly designed 360° rotating glass device that generates kinetic motion activation via cascading water displacement, opposing airflow technology, and the natural force of gravity. It is constructed using the highest quality materials, including borosilicate glass globes and aircraft-grade anodized aluminum.

Covered under US Patent Numbers: 12,035,752, D943,817, D970,804, Canada Industrial Design Patent Numbers 200939, 215021, EUIPO 008421937-0001 and other foreign and domestic patents pending.

- Created in collaboration with world-renowned American rock band and timeless cultural icons, Grateful Dead
- Built-in percolation system delivers water-filtered, cooled smoke
- Easy maintenance and simple to clean
- Contactless consumption

Anodized Aluminum Frame
Borosilicate Glass Globes
Silicone Hose Assembly
